tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. The warm cream from the logo ground; in dark, a deep teal-black.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, menus and inputs sitting on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, progress tracks, empty photo slots, code and metadata blocks.

tokens.name: surface-frame
tokens.usage: The photo mat: the cream border around photo tiles and the app icon frame. Also selected rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and around cards. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary button borders. 3.4:1 on `surface`, 3.5:1 on `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface token. The wordmark teal; 10:1 or better in light, 12:1 or better in dark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, hints, timestamps. 4.8:1 or better on all four surfaces in both themes.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, switch on, selected photo ring. The one main action per view.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `primary` fills.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` and `primary-hover` (8.2:1 or better).

tokens.name: pine
tokens.usage: Secondary brand green from the back photo tile. Progress fills, uploading status, links. Text-safe on all surfaces (6:1 or better).

tokens.name: pine-soft
tokens.usage: Background for uploading badges and pine highlights. Pair with `pine` text (5.4:1 or better).

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: The sun. Accent fill for the New badge, illustration and the cover. Never as text; text on it is `on-sun`.

tokens.name: on-sun
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `sun` fills (5.4:1).

tokens.name: sun-ink
tokens.usage: Orange as text: warnings and the New label. 5.2:1 or better on every surface and on `peach-soft`.

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: The sky in the logo. Illustration, placeholder art, storage meter segment. Not for text grounds in dark.

tokens.name: peach-soft
tokens.usage: Background for New and warning badges. Pair with `sun-ink` text.

tokens.name: hill
tokens.usage: Illustration only: the hill shape in placeholders, empty states and the cover.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Backed up. A blue-teal, kept off the red-green axis so it never relies on hue against `danger`. Always with the check icon and a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background for backed-up badges. Pair with `success` text (5.1:1 or better).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Needs attention: failed uploads, storage full, destructive actions. Always with the attention icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background for attention badges and inline errors. Pair with `danger` text.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px gap in the surface colour, then a solid 2px ring. 3.9:1 or better on every surface.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Marketing headlines and onboarding. One per screen.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Album names, list item titles, dialog titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: All 3,880 photos from this phone are safely backed up.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Hints, secondary lines, captions under photos. Usually in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Section labels above lists. Set uppercase in CSS; write the source text in sentence case.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: File names, sizes, counts and checksums. Tabular numbers that should not jump while uploading.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between photo tiles in a dense grid; icon to label in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked form rows and badge rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page margins on desktop, empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero and onboarding spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small thumbnails, checkboxes, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Photo tiles and the app icon shape: the soft square from the logo.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, switches, progress bars.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and resting cards.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Photo tiles, menus, the soft lift under the logo's tiles.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the photo viewer.
